p01_project_adaptation.status: Explicit project adaptation required by scope change; not historical original mission behaviour.

handoff_rule: Read this scope before earlier research/handoffs. Retain space missions and explicitly map former planetside stages to station handoffs. Do not bulk-enable a pack or separately excluded Frontier/Operations IDs. All research permissions remain in force.
prior_exclusions_retained: Frontier/First Encounters missions and every Elite Dangerous Operation remain excluded; this clarification does not re-enable them.

mission_eligibility_policy.unit: Individual mission, not entire expansion pack or campaign
mission_eligibility_policy.required: Playable project objectives are space flight or space-station services.
mission_eligibility_policy.original_ground_content: Reference-only. Replace the ground element of retained mixed missions with an explicit space-station handoff.
mission_eligibility_policy.mixed_campaign: Retain eligible space missions and mapped station-handoff adaptations; do not exclude the whole campaign.
mission_eligibility_policy.unknown: Disabled pending complete mission and handoff mapping; membership in active_catalogue_ids is insufficient.
mission_eligibility_policy.adaptation: Station-handoff-specifications.md governs replacements. P01 space-station supply is retained. Record every original stage, station, requirements, state effects and branch/reward mapping.
mission_eligibility_policy.allowed_services: Space-station docking, briefings, cargo/passenger loading, equipment transactions and mission handoffs.
mission_eligibility_policy.excluded_play: Walking, SRV, atmospheric flight, planetary-surface docking and ground combat.
mission_eligibility_policy.save_migration: An older save at a replaced ground stage migrates to its corresponding station handoff without duplicate items/rewards or dependence on the original ground sequence.
